# Dev
name: Build & Push (dev / site-output)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ dev ]
    # Only run if site-output/ changes
    paths: [ 'site-output/**' ]
  # Enable manual triggering
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: Branch, tag, or SHA to build
        required: false
        default: dev

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # ⬅️ push through the host-exposed NodePort so DinD can reach it
      REGISTRY: reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000
      IMAGE_NAME: cm
      TAG_SHA: dev-${{ github.sha }}
      TAG_MAJOR: latest
      DEFAULT_BRANCH: dev
      DEFAULT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      FALLBACK_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
      TARGET_REF: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.ref || '' }}

    steps:
      - name: Install SSH client (if missing)
        run: |
          set -e
          if ! command -v ssh-keyscan >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update -y
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssh-client
          fi

      - name: DNS & connectivity checks (in-cluster)
        env:
          GITEA_SVC_HOST: gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local
          GITEA_SSH_PORT: "2222"
          REGISTRY_HOSTPORT: reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "=== resolv.conf ==="; cat /etc/resolv.conf || true; echo
          echo "=== getent hosts (gitea ssh svc) ==="
          getent hosts "$GITEA_SVC_HOST" || (echo "FATAL: cannot resolve $GITEA_SVC_HOST" && exit 1)
          echo
          echo "=== TCP check gitea ssh ==="
          timeout 5 bash -c ">/dev/tcp/$GITEA_SVC_HOST/$GITEA_SSH_PORT" || (echo "FATAL: cannot reach $GITEA_SVC_HOST:$GITEA_SSH_PORT" && exit 1)
          echo "OK"; echo
          echo "=== getent hosts (registry) ==="
          REGISTRY_HOST="${REGISTRY_HOSTPORT%%:*}"
          getent hosts "$REGISTRY_HOST" || (echo "FATAL: cannot resolve $REGISTRY_HOST" && exit 1)
          echo
          echo "=== TCP check registry ==="
          REGISTRY_PORT="${REGISTRY_HOSTPORT##*:}"
          timeout 5 bash -c ">/dev/tcp/$REGISTRY_HOST/$REGISTRY_PORT" || (echo "FATAL: cannot reach $REGISTRY_HOSTPORT" && exit 1)
          echo "OK"

      - name: Setup SSH material
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -m 700 -d ~/.ssh
          printf "%s\n" "${{ secrets.CI_DEPLOY_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_ci
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ci
          ssh-keyscan -p 2222 gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local > ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          chmod 644 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          {
            echo "Host gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local"
            echo "  User git"
            echo "  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ci"
            echo "  IdentitiesOnly yes"
            echo "  StrictHostKeyChecking yes"
          } >> ~/.ssh/config

      - name: Clone repo (SSH via in-cluster service)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          REPO_SSH="ssh://git@gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local:2222/radiostatic/static-site-gen.git"
          TARGET_INPUT="${TARGET_REF:-}"
          DEFAULT_BRANCH="${DEFAULT_BRANCH:-dev}"
          DEFAULT_SHA="${DEFAULT_SHA:-}"
          FALLBACK_REF="${FALLBACK_REF:-}"

          if [[ -z "$TARGET_INPUT" ]]; then
            if [[ -n "$DEFAULT_SHA" ]]; then
              TARGET="$DEFAULT_SHA"
            elif [[ -n "$FALLBACK_REF" ]]; then
              TARGET="$FALLBACK_REF"
            else
              TARGET="refs/heads/${DEFAULT_BRANCH}"
            fi
          else
            TARGET="$TARGET_INPUT"
          fi

          if [[ "$TARGET" != refs/* && ! "$TARGET" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then
            TARGET="refs/heads/$TARGET"
          fi

          if [[ "$TARGET" == refs/heads/* ]]; then
            BRANCH="${TARGET#refs/heads/}"
            git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BRANCH" "$REPO_SSH" .
          elif [[ "$TARGET" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            TAG="${TARGET#refs/tags/}"
            git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_SSH" .
            git fetch --depth 1 origin "refs/tags/$TAG:refs/tags/$TAG" || git fetch origin "refs/tags/$TAG"
            git checkout "tags/$TAG"
          elif [[ "$TARGET" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then
            git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_SSH" .
            git fetch --depth 1 origin "$TARGET" || git fetch origin "$TARGET" || git fetch origin
            git checkout --detach "$TARGET"
          elif [[ -n "$TARGET" ]]; then
            git clone --depth 1 --branch "$TARGET" "$REPO_SSH" . || {
              git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_SSH" .
              git fetch --depth 1 origin "$TARGET" || git fetch origin "$TARGET" || true
              git checkout --detach "$TARGET" || git checkout "$TARGET" || true
            }
          else
            git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_SSH" .
            if [[ -n "${GITHUB_SHA:-}" ]]; then
              git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GITHUB_SHA}" || git fetch origin
              git checkout --detach "${GITHUB_SHA}"
            fi
          fi

          BUILD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "BUILD_SHA=${BUILD_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "TAG_SHA=dev-${BUILD_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Cache stagit fallback tarball
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p scripts/stagit
          if compgen -G 'scripts/stagit/stagit-*.tar.gz' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stagit tarball already cached; skipping download"
            exit 0
          fi

          refs=(main master)
          mirrors=(
            "rski/stagit"
          )

          for ref in "${refs[@]}"; do
            for mirror in "${mirrors[@]}"; do
              url="https://codeload.github.com/${mirror}/stagit/tar.gz/refs/heads/${ref}"
              tmp="$(mktemp scripts/stagit/stagit-download-XXXXXX.tar.gz)"
              if curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$tmp"; then
                dest="scripts/stagit/stagit-${ref}.tar.gz"
                mv "$tmp" "$dest"
                ln -sfn "$(basename "$dest")" scripts/stagit/stagit-fallback.tar.gz
                echo "Cached stagit ${ref} tarball from ${mirror}"
                exit 0
              fi
              rm -f "$tmp"
            done
          done

          echo "WARNING: Unable to cache stagit tarball from remote mirrors; using bundled archive if available" >&2

      - name: Install stagit toolchain
        run: |
          scripts/install-stagit.sh

      - name: Generate stagit HTML (dev check)
        env:
          STAGIT_REPOLIST: ${{ github.workspace }}/config/stagit/manifest.txt
          STAGIT_REPOBASE: ${{ github.workspace }}/tmp/stagit/repos
          STAGIT_HTMLBASE: ${{ github.workspace }}/tmp/stagit/html
          STAGIT_ASSETSDIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/tmp/stagit/html/_assets
          STAGIT_SHARED_ASSETS: style.css logo.png favicon.png
          STAGIT_URL_REWRITE: >-
            git@gitea.core.home.arpa:32222/=>ssh://git@gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local:2222/,ssh://git@gitea.core.home.arpa:32222/=>ssh://git@gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local:2222/
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf tmp/stagit
          mkdir -p tmp/stagit/html/_assets
          if [ -d config/stagit/assets ]; then
            cp -a config/stagit/assets/. tmp/stagit/html/_assets/
          fi
          scripts/update-stagit.sh

      - name: Copy stagit mirror into site output
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ ! -d tmp/stagit/html ]; then
            echo "WARN: stagit HTML directory missing; skipping copy" >&2
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p site-output
          rm -rf site-output/git
          cp -a tmp/stagit/html site-output/git

      - name: Upload stagit HTML artifact (dev)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: stagit-html-dev
          path: tmp/stagit/html
          retention-days: 3

      # Only runs if creds exist; fine to keep — if your registry is no-auth, it will be skipped.
      - name: Registry login (optional)
        if: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME != '' && secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD != '' }}
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}

      # ⬅️ Teach BuildKit that the NodePort registry is HTTP/insecure
      - name: Set up Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        with:
          config-inline: |
            [registry."reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000"]
              http = true
              insecure = true

      - name: Build & push image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile.dev
          no-cache: true
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ env.TAG_SHA }}
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ env.TAG_MAJOR }}

      - name: Output image refs
        run: |
          echo "Pushed:"
          echo "  ${REGISTRY}/${IMAGE_NAME}:${TAG_SHA}"
          echo "  ${REGISTRY}/${IMAGE_NAME}:${TAG_MAJOR}"
